_original_lore: Keep this item in your inventory to
when you leave or when you click
This item becomes imbued with the
magic of the Dragon when it spawns,
turning it into a Remnant of the Eye.
name: 沉睡之眼

source: Keep this item in your inventory to
when you leave or when you click
loreParagraphs.translation: 将此物品保留在物品栏中,以便在你离开或点击末地祭坛时取回已放置的召唤之眼.

source: This item becomes imbued with the
magic of the Dragon when it spawns,
turning it into a Remnant of the Eye.
loreParagraphs.translation: 当巨龙生成时,此物品会被龙之魔法灌注,变成残存之眼.
